description: Comprehensive debloat rules for BBK Electronics smartphone brands: Oppo (ColorOS), Vivo (FuntouchOS/OriginOS), and Realme (Realme UI).

rules.name: Oppo / Realme App Market
rules.description: Secondary app market with aggressive ad notifications, recommended app popups, and auto-downloading bloatware.

rules.name: Vivo V-Appstore
rules.description: Vivo proprietary app store. Safe to disable when using Google Play Store.

rules.name: HeyTap Browser
rules.description: Preloaded web browser filled with sponsored bookmarks, trending video ads, and search tracking.

rules.name: Vivo Browser
rules.description: Preloaded Vivo web browser with trending news advertisements and sponsored search engines.

rules.name: HeyTap Theme Store
rules.description: Storefront for purchasing wallpapers, lockscreens, and system fonts.

rules.name: iTheme (Vivo Themes)
rules.description: Vivo theme marketplace client.

rules.name: HeyTap Global Search
rules.description: Swipe-down search widget featuring trending app ads and web suggestions.

rules.name: Vivo Global Search
rules.description: System search bar pushing sponsored search queries and promotional apps.

rules.name: HeyTap Video
rules.description: Online video aggregator with banner ads preloaded on Oppo and Realme devices.

rules.name: HeyTap Music
rules.description: Music player with commercial audio streaming promotions.

rules.name: Jovi Voice Assistant
rules.description: Vivo proprietary voice assistant. Safe to disable if using Google Assistant or no assistant.

rules.name: Jovi Home (HiBoard)
rules.description: Negative-one home screen feed pushing sponsored news, shortcuts, and promotional cards.

rules.name: Vivo iManager Telemetry
rules.description: Background system manager known for aggressive RAM killing, security scanning, and battery stats logging.

rules.name: ColorOS Phone Manager
rules.description: System cleaner and storage scanner bundled on ColorOS and Realme UI.

rules.name: ColorOS Game Space
rules.description: Gaming overlay with community ads and network acceleration promos.

rules.name: Vivo Game Center
rules.description: Game store and floating in-game overlay from Vivo.

rules.name: Smart Assistant (Breeno Feed)
rules.description: ColorOS leftmost smart widget screen displaying sponsored cards and quick apps.

rules.name: Glance Lockscreen Platform
rules.description: Sponsored lockscreen news stories, ad wallpapers, and video teasers. Major battery consumer.

rules.name: ColorOS Lockscreen Magazine
rules.description: Lockscreen wallpaper carousel displaying promotional commercial images.

rules.name: Vivo Lockscreen Poster
rules.description: Lockscreen dynamic wallpapers with advertising headlines.

rules.name: Vivo EasyShare
rules.description: File transfer utility for copying data between Vivo phones.

rules.name: Oppo Roaming
rules.description: Virtual SIM international data roaming market.

rules.name: Redtea Mobile Roaming
rules.description: eSIM data roaming marketplace preloaded on BBK handsets.
